label: Whatever has power for the actual contingents' joint absence has an invariant set-up
paraphrase: OPEN (analyst formulation): whatever has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w has an invariant set-up at w: no intrinsic state of it and no external condition of its giving differs at an accessible world where it exists. The simplicity-and-patientlessness reading of #1897's holder; not derived from its necessity (a necessary holder with world-varying intrinsic states is a model of its failure).
